new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Meet our Professional Services Team!

Successful implementation and value from the Sprinklr platform starts with us. As customers advance their strategies and invest more in social media as a business driver, we’re looking for experienced project managers to help realise those ambitions. As a member of our team, you’ll support our customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.

What You'll Do

Sprinklr is looking for a Global Program Manager to manage enterprise level projects for some of our biggest clients. You will be both responsible and accountable for the end to end delivery of projects across a range of clients .

Responsibilities:

Own and manage a portfolio consisting of 5 - 7 accounts; controlling project scope, change control processes, risks/ issues and mitigation plans.
Partner with consulting teams, leaders and other internal departments or regional teams to coordinate and drive delivery.
Ensure that overall program is effective, whilst running individual projects according to schedule and keeping within budget.
Develop relationships with, and ensure the appropriate participation of key client & internal stakeholders and executives.
Develop, build, and maintain durable and trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
Develop knowledge of the Sprinklr platform components and module-synergies - so as to be able to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and high-level solutions.
Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed effectively.
Manage client service expectations and briefs and drive successful, measurable outcomes for the client.
Set the tone for the team and strive for quality and excellence in all aspects of delivery.
Provide weekly project status and burn reports to the relevant project stakeholders.
Maintain awareness of the current industry environment that shapes opportunities for client solutions.

Experience:

Extensive experience of client management experience collaborating closely with business owners and executive level clients.
Experienced managing projects in IT, SaaS, Social, or Software environment.
Experienced working with multi-geo, multicultural delivery teams.
Experienced working on large scale project management in leading multi-organisational initiatives, and driving team accountability to achieve goals.
Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk, develop detailed work plans and specifications, perform resource allocations and run team meetings.
Demonstrated ability to assume a leadership role in managing project, departmental and enterprise risks related to projects, systems and business analysis.
Strong influencing skills and negotiation / mediation skills.
Ability to motivate and focus people resources where there is no direct reporting relationship.
Proven mentoring, supervisory, and team-building skills.
Ability to resolve problems with keen instincts and organisational experience.
Strong knowledge of software development life cycles, web technologies, web development processes.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Experience in Agile project management a plus.
Certification of any kind for Project Management (Prince2, PMP, SCRUM etc.)
Experience in CCAAS delivery/rollout

We focus on our mission
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

EEO - Our philosophy
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful. 

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Key Responsibilities

Lead medium to large, multi-discipline nuclear projects from early planning and design through implementation, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
Coordinate with lead managers, discipline leads, and project teams across business units to ensure alignment on technical scope, priorities, and deliverables.

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Business Process Manager

We Are Hiring 3 Implementation Managers To Drive Our Global Quote-to-Order Transformation. You Will Join a Key Initiative To Standardize Commercial Processes And Digital Solutions Across Our Business. Apply For The Region That Matches Your Profile And Career Aspirations

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Compensation Package

For candidates applying from Italy:

As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to share the compensation details for this position:

Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico

Minimum annual salary: €53.000

Variable Pay: AIP target % + Eligible for Company Productivity Bonus

Country-specific benefits will be discussed with shortlisted candidates based on location.

The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Benefits As Per Policy

Flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and a strong focus on work-life integration and Wellbeing support for employees and their families

Welfare plan with a wide range of personalized services

Canteen or meal vouchers provided

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Meet our Professional Services Team!

Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We’re looking for experienced CCaaS project managers to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you’ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.

What You'll Do

Sprinklr is looking for a Project Manager with expertise in CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) operations to manage enterprise-level projects for Sprinklr’s largest customers. In this role, you will be both responsible for the end-to-end delivery of multi-market, global implementations across multiple customer verticals.

Responsibilities:

Own and manage end-to-end project management of CCaaS implementation including stakeholder management, project scope, product enhancements, change control processes, and risk mitigation plans.
The Project Manager ensures that customer business requirements and KPIs are being implemented according to defined scope, requirements and best practices and value is being delivered at every touch point.
Partner with Sprinklr’s cross-functional enablement functions and leaders to ensure alignment and transparency at every project stage.
Drive meaningful relationships with key customer and internal stakeholders, as well as executives, ensuring all parties are providing requisite participation and accountability.
Maintain deep Sprinklr platform knowledge to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and workstreams.
Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed and communicated effectively.
Lead a team striving for quality and excellence in all aspects of project delivery.
Provide weekly project status and burn

reports to the relevant project stakeholders.

Maintain awareness of the CCaaS industry to provide subject matter expertise and guidance internally and for Sprinklr customers.

Experience:

Fluent in English and Arabic (Mandatory)
5 + years' Experience in CCaaS delivery/deployment, Contact Centers, or similar industry
Experience in global (multi-geo/multi-cultural) rollouts
Strong Project Management experience coupled with certifications such as PMP, Prince2 Agile, ACP strongly preferred
Strong stakeholder management experience including at the executive level
Experience managing various deployment types (centralized, decentralized, huband-spoke)
Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk models, perform resource allocations and run large-scale cross-functional team meetings
Ability to lead and motivate large teams without direct supervision, leveraging mediation and stakeholder management skills
Strong knowledge of software development life cycles
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Experience:

Contact center operations
Contact center network, ACD/IVR, dialer, workforce management, software or other solution operations or technical experience
Technical configuration experience with CCaaS or similar SaaS solutions

We focus on our mission
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

EEO - Our philosophy
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful. 

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

Warning about Recruiting Scams:
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

Motorola Mobility | Mobile Business Group (MBG)

At Motorola, we build world-class mobile and wearable experiences on a foundation of Android, focusing on delivering meaningful, customer-centric innovations.

As a Software Product Manager (SPM)
on the AIW team, you will define, drive, and deliver software products that leverage on-device AI and wearable innovation

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy Vision

Translate emerging AI capabilities (e.g., on-device AI, contextual intelligence) into differentiated user value
Identify market opportunities and drive competitive positioning aligned to Motorola’s software philosophy

Execution Delivery

Own end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization
Partner with engineering teams to translate requirements into deliverable features and releases
Define product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and delivery timelines
Drive prioritization decisions balancing user impact, technical feasibility, and business goals

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with:
Software engineering (Android, AI frameworks)
UX/design
Data science/AI teams
Marketing and business stakeholders

Lead cross-functional alignment and decision-making across global teams
Ensure strong inter-group coordination and execution discipline

AI Innovation Focus

Drive adoption of on-device AI technologies to enable real-time, efficient user experiences
Partner with engineering to integrate AI models, frameworks, and features into Motorola devices
Identify opportunities to differentiate through AI in wearables, smartphones, and emerging form factors

Customer Market Insights

Gather and synthesize customer insights, usage data, and feedback
Conduct competitive analysis and benchmark Motorola experiences against industry leaders
Continuously improve product performance and user satisfaction

Ensure continuous improvement of software experiences and timely updates

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

new_jobs.title: Lead Market Intelligence Analyst & Writer
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, highly analytical market researcher and writer to serve as our Lead Market Intelligence Analyst & Writer
. This hands-on role transforms market data, industry research, economic indicators, regulatory developments, and competitive intelligence into actionable insights and high-quality reports for clients.

The Lead Market Intelligence Analyst & Writer will research assigned markets and industries, identify meaningful trends and market shifts, analyze historical and current data, and develop forward-looking perspectives. You will translate complex findings into clear, compelling insights for executive audiences.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable analyzing datasets, conducting primary and secondary research, identifying patterns and business implications, developing data visualizations, and producing polished client-facing content.

In addition to producing original research, the Lead will lead, mentor, and review the work of other Market Analyst Writers. You will help establish consistent research methodologies, content priorities, project plans, editorial standards, and quality-control practices across the market intelligence team.

This role is ideal for someone who is curious by nature and enjoys digging into complex markets, understanding what the data reveals, anticipating what may come next, and turning those insights into concise, compelling stories.

In this role, regular collaboration with distributed technology teams across multiple time zones, including teams in the United States and India, is required.

As a premier consulting and technology firm, alliant is focused on providing solutions to help businesses transform and thrive, while serving as their ongoing growth partner.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct and maintain comprehensive research on assigned markets, industries, companies, technologies, supply chains, funding trends, regulations, and economic conditions.
Gather and evaluate information from government and regulatory sources, industry and company publications, financial and market databases, academic research, internal data, and interviews with industry participants and subject-matter experts.
Identify, validate, and document quantitative and qualitative data, including each source’s reliability, methodology, limitations, and timeliness.
Monitor developments and emerging trends that may affect the market outlook.
Analyze and compare historical, current, and projected market data across industries, companies, geographies, labor markets, and technologies.
Evaluate market size, growth or contraction, segmentation, demand, pricing, competition, investment activity, adoption rates, and other relevant indicators.
Identify the factors driving market growth, contraction, disruption, and structural change.
Distinguish meaningful market signals from temporary fluctuations and develop evidence-based perspectives on the causes and implications of market changes.
Translate complex quantitative and qualitative analysis into clear business implications and executive-level insights.
Develop evidence-based market forecasts, scenarios, and long-term outlooks that identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks, disruptions, and potential inflection points.
Explain the assumptions, evidence, methodologies, and limitations underlying forecasts.
Periodically compare actual market outcomes with prior expectations to evaluate and improve forecasting accuracy.
Monitor enacted and proposed legislation, regulations, government programs, tax policies, standards, and regulatory guidance that may affect assigned markets.
Assess the potential effects of regulatory and policy developments on industries, companies, technologies, costs, investment, demand, and competition, and incorporate relevant findings into market reports and forecasts.
Incorporate relevant regulatory insights into market reports, forecasts, and trend analyses.
Maintain current regulatory and policy timelines for assigned markets.
Create clear and accurate charts, graphs, tables, and other visualizations using methods appropriate to the underlying data and business message.
Ensure all visualizations represent the underlying data accurately and objectively.
Transform complex data and analysis into compelling visual and written narratives that connect findings, insights, business implications, and conclusions for executive audiences.
Serve as a hands-on leader who conducts research, analysis, and writing while providing day-to-day guidance and quality oversight to a team of Market Analyst Writers.
Review research plans, analytical approaches, reports, visualizations, forecasts, and conclusions to identify gaps, strengthen analytical rigor, and ensure publication readiness.
Coach and mentor analysts in research methodology, data analysis, visualization, professional writing, and the development of clear executive-level insights.
Provide constructive feedback that helps analysts distinguish facts, assumptions, analysis, forecasts, and recommendations.
Establish and maintain quality standards, research templates, processes, and best practices that promote consistent, credible, and executive-ready deliverables.
Prioritize research assignments and support effective workload management across the team.
Support the hiring, onboarding, training, and professional development of Market Analyst Writers, as needed.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, Journalism, Communications, Market Research, Social Sciences, or a related field is required.
Master’s degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, Market Research, Journalism, or a related field preferred.
5+ years of professional experience in market research, industry analysis, competitive intelligence, business analysis, economic or financial research, consulting, journalism, or a related field required.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage research projects from initial inquiry through analysis and final publication.
Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret quantitative and qualitative information.
Experience evaluating source credibility and validating research findings.
Exceptional business writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling insights for executive and business audiences.
Experience working in a market research, analyst, consulting, investment or economic re-search, industry publication, or comparable research environment preferred.
Experience producing professional, client-facing, or publicly available research reports preferred.
Experience developing market forecasts and scenario analyses preferred
Experience conducting primary research through interviews, surveys, and other qualitative or quantitative methods preferred
Experience researching and analyzing regulatory and legislative developments preferred
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar visualization platforms preferred
Experience with Python, R, SQL, or similar analytical tools preferred
Strong Excel or equivalent spreadsheet and data-analysis skills.
Experience creating professional charts, graphs, tables, and other data visualizations.
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to research integrity and factual accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple research priorities and deadlines effectively.
Experience reviewing work and mentoring analysts, researchers, writers, or similar professionals.
High sense of urgency with the ability to meet deadlines and changing priorities. 
Receptiveness to performance feedback within a team environment is essential. 
Ability to work onsite in Houston, TX, five days per week.

These program support services include the collection, analysis, and dissemination of investigative information as well as coordination and implementation of administrative services and program requirements supporting NSE workflow and team operations, personnel management, and travel arrangements. Report individual findings on an ongoing basis to lead personnel.

Resolve any problems and questions concerning data to be entered.

Possess a working knowledge of current investigative techniques relating the analyzing and summarizing large volumes of investigative data and preparing analytical products in support of law enforcement operations.

new_jobs.title: Counterintelligence Analyst with Security Clearance
new_jobs.description:
Description Position Overview DARPAs All-Source intelligence/counterintelligence (CI) program includes detecting, identifying, assessing, and, in conjunction with the assigned CI support activity, analyzing information on adversary intentions and capabilities. This may include developing programs, systems, and procedures designed to counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities of foreign entities, including sabotage and terrorist activities. All-Source/CI analysts recommend cost-effective protective measures and countermeasures for DARPA personnel, programs, and activities. All-Source/CI Analyst will enable DARPAs organic intelligence/CI program to realize the positive attributes inherent in combining IC resources with a trained/qualified internal multi-disciplined security team in applying All-Source Intelligence/CI context to protecting DARPA programs. This nascent internal structure will develop or adapt existing programs, systems, and procedures to proactively counter foreign intelligence collection efforts and activities, including sabotage and terrorist activities. The All-Source/CI Analyst will perform the following responsibilities:

Determine essential elements of information, and conduct activities to detect, identify, assess, exploit, and proactively counter or neutralize hostile intelligence collection, sabotage, and terrorist activities
Plan special analytical projects in response to client assignments which include analytical approach, schedule, personnel requirements, data collection, travel, assessment criteria, and costs
Research and collect required data, perform analysis, and summarize findings in response to client requests
Compile detailed reports of analysis clearly defining the problem or issue, factors considered, findings, and provide clear, concise conclusions and recommendations
Develop innovative and proactive analytical methodologies, refining existing program protection analytical methodologies to meet evolving program needs
Provide intelligence/CI input and assist PSRs, PMs, and SETAs in developing Program Protection Plans
Review and provide comments on Program Protection Plans, Test Plans, OPSEC Plans, and other planning documentation as required
Assist Technical Office management, PMs, SETAs, and security personnel in performing SAP lifecycle threat analysis
Apply analytical methodologies to existing programs to review, and readdress, if necessary, their protection needs to remain consistent with changes in diplomatic, political, and military environments
Perform short-notice contingency and exposure analysis, summarizing implications, and providing viable responses and recommended courses of action
Work with individual program management personnel to assist in analyzing and developing solutions to unique or difficult CI-related issues
Review organizational mission statements and associated publicly available information for inconsistencies which may reveal sensitive information
Review, analyze, and, where appropriate, make recommendations to long-term program protection policies and practices
Provide intelligence and CI threat data and analysis to support assessments and surveys of agency-wide OPSEC programs
Assist DARPA PMs in identification of program CPI and assist in the development of agency-wide and program-specific OPSEC plans, and make recommendations for additions or changes where appropriate
Participate, as appropriate, in program management and planning meetings, and working sessions to provide an intelligence/CI perspective
Receive information of CI value from technical security inspections, foreign travel reporting, international relations/security, visitor control, AT/FP, or other sources of potential FIE or CI related activity
Prepare and deliver comprehensive briefings to increase CI awareness and to inform senior DARPA leadership
Establish lines of communication and professional relationships with other Federal and DoD agencies within the IC
Other duties as assigned Qualifications Required Skills (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities)
Understanding the Intelligence Community composition, including the roles and responsibilities of the IC components; methodologies inherent in Insider Threats; elicitation methods and procedures; counter-elicitation methods and procedures; CI indicators of motivation; methods of information collection and information transmittal; the basics and methodologies employed in Competitive Intelligence and Economic Espionage practices; foreign intelligence/CI threat data and the agencies acquiring it (including general, site specific, and technical); implications to DARPA program efforts from various threats; and understanding, prioritizing, and counteracting threats.
Attend meetings (either locally or out-of-area) and create meeting summaries or trip reports
Prepare and submit meeting minutes on an as-required basis
Prepare/present briefings, incorporating graphics (if appropriate) for/to SID and DARPA leaders
Prepare various security forms associated with their duties
Assist in entry control and perform escort duties for visitors
Answer telephones and other modes of administrative communications in the performance of duties
Perform self-inspections, identify security discrepancies, and report security incidents
Perform, or support, security inspections, identify security discrepancies and prepare reports
Perform courier duties within the continental United States (CONUS)
Perform user-level security administrator and information security responsibilities as required and in compliance with US Codes, Executive Orders, and DoD and DARPA policy
Perform objective reviews on all documentation encountered during performance of duties
Possess the energy, experience, and subject matter expertise to demonstrate sound judgment, foresight and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced S&T RDT&E environment
Possess excellent organizational and communication skills; demonstrating an ability to communicate, interact easily and effectively with a wide variety of individuals and echelons in both written and verbal forms
Manage and maintain detailed information and documentation
Possess excellent research and data-gathering skills with an ability to interpret/analyze complex information within operational Research & Development (R&D) / S&T environments
Work independently, as well as in a team environment, within the bounds and guidelines of the organization Clearance
Minimum of active Top Secret (TS)
TS/SCI strongly desired
Subject to a random counterintelligence scope polygraphs as a condition of access eligibility. Years of Experience/Education Requirements

The Business Data Analyst owns the analytical layer between data infrastructure and decision-making — turning warehouse data into dashboards, metrics, and insights that drive product, growth, and operations decisions. Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst
, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

How You'll Make an Impact:

📊 Build confidence in business decisions by designing analyses and communicating insights that help teams understand what is working – and what isn't.

📈 Turn data into strategic direction by uncovering trends, identifying opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations.

📉 Create visibility into organizational performance through dashboards, reporting, and metrics that stakeholders rely on every day.

🤝 Partner with cross-functional teams to frame business problems, evaluate options, and ensure decisions are supported by data.

🎯 Develop meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that enable teams to consistently measure success and track progress over time.

🔍 Identify opportunities to improve business processes, customer experiences, and operational efficiency through thoughtful analysis.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

🧩 Use data to drive decisions.

You have a track record of solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and influencing decisions with data.

📊 Have strong analytical fundamentals.

SQL is a core part of your toolkit, and you're comfortable working with large datasets to uncover meaningful insights.

📈 Think beyond reporting.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

💬 Communicate with clarity.

You can explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and help stakeholders make informed decisions.

🤝 Enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

Company Overview

Brother is a leading provider of home and office equipment, sewing and crafting products, and industrial solutions. With a legacy spanning over 115 years, our brand is renowned for producing award-winning printers, sewing machines, P-touch labelers, and more. Brother Canada was established in 1960, marking over 65 years of operations. Brother Canada is headquartered in Dollard-des-Ormeaux, Quebec and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Brother International Corporation (BIC), based in the United States. BIC is in itself a subsidiary of Brother Industries Limited (BIL), which was founded in 1908 in Nagoya, Japan and operates in more than 30 countries worldwide.

Why Work at Brother?

At Brother Canada, we’re more than a team; we’re a community guided by our culture drivers of Accountability, Authenticity, Excellence, and Boldness. We foster collaboration, growth, and work-life balance through flexible hours, hybrid work options, wellness subsidies, learning and development, recognition programs, and employee discounts. With roots in Montreal since 1960, we embrace continuous improvement and a culture of “Challenging Spirit,” offering stability while delivering a superior customer experience.

Role Overview

Reporting to the Director, B2C Sales, the B2C Sales Operations Analyst
supports the B2C Sales team by managing sales reporting, analytics, and operational processes. The role works closely with B2C Sales team members, internal stakeholders from cross functional teams, and key retail accounts to consolidate and analyze sales, inventory, order, and promotional information. By delivering accurate reporting, actionable insights, and responsive operational support, the Analyst helps the sales team make informed decisions, identify business opportunities, and maintain strong customer relationships.

Duties & Responsibilities

Reporting & Data Analysis

Prepare and distribute accurate weekly and monthly sales, purchase, cancellation, inventory, order, and point-of-sale reports for assigned retail accounts and sales channels
Consolidate data from multiple internal and external sources, validate its accuracy, investigate discrepancies, and escalate significant issues when required
Analyze sales performance, inventory, order plans, and promotional activity to identify trends, risks, gaps, and business opportunities
Translate reporting results into clear insights and recommendations that support account planning and B2C Sales decision-making
Maintain retail account reporting tools and dashboards, ensuring information is accurate, current, and available according to established reporting timelines
Prepare reporting materials and business updates for internal reviews, customer meetings, and account-planning discussions
Identify and implement opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, information flow, process efficiency, and stakeholder experience

Sales, Accounts & Cross-Functional Support

Monitor weekly order-plan performance and collaborate with account buying teams, account managers, and Supply
Chain to address forecast, inventory, or order-related issues

Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product Management, Supply Chain, and other internal stakeholders to respond to customer and account information requests
Support promotional planning and execution by maintaining relevant information, monitoring activity, and communicating changes or issues to appropriate stakeholders

Customer & Additional Support

Perform other related duties and support ad hoc projects as assigned

Education

University degree or college diploma in business, commerce, analytics, supply chain, finance, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

Experience

At least three years of experience in sales operations, sales support, retail account support, customer service, supply chain, business analytics, or a related field
Experience in consumer electronics, consumer packaged goods, retail, or another product-based industry Preferred
Experience supporting major retail or e-commerce accounts Preferred

Languages

Bilingual
Proficiency in both written and verbal English communication is essential for effective correspondence with clients, suppliers, business partners and colleagues beyond the province of Quebec

Skills / Knowledge / Abilities

Demonstrated ability to consolidate, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and the organization and analysis of large data sets
Experience preparing recurring reports, dashboards, or sales performance analyses
Strong attention to detail and demonstrated commitment to data accuracy and quality
Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate underlying causes, and raise issues or risks in a timely manner
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and changing priorities
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and external customer contacts
Experience working with point-of-sale, inventory, order, forecast, and promotional data Preferred
Experience using Tableau or another business intelligence and data-visualization platform Preferred
Experience improving reporting processes, dashboards, or data-quality controls Preferred

Additional Details For This Role

Hybrid Work Setting – Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid model, with three days working remotely and two days in the office each week, supporting work-life balance and meaningful in-person collaboration. Exceptions may apply according to business needs. ##Joinbrothercanada

Our health and wellness benefits go beyond the basics, with medical, dental, vision, mental health support, financial advisors, and fitness programs to keep your mind and body in top shape. We’re big believers in recharging your batteries, with flexible vacation, personal days, summer hours, and a company-wide holiday shutdown so you can enjoy real downtime. new_jobs.title: 35F Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

On the battlefield, success depends on accurate and timely intel. As an Army National Guard Intelligence Analyst, you will play a key role in the interpretation and exploitation of information gathered from or about the threat. Intelligence Analysts provide Guard personnel with information about enemy forces and potential battle areas, and use information derived from all intelligence disciplines to determine changes in enemy capabilities, vulnerabilities, and probable courses of action. You’ll gain Military Intelligence training, education, and a security clearance that could open doors to rewarding career opportunities with other intelligence agencies.

Specific duties of the Intelligence Analyst may include: preparing all-source intelligence products; providing Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Synchronization support; processing incoming reports and messages; determining the significance and reliability of incoming information; establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-referencing intelligence records and files; integrating incoming information with current intelligence holdings; and preparing and maintaining enemy situational graphics.

Job Duties

Preparing all-source intelligence products to support the combat commander
Assessing the significance and reliability of incoming intelligence collection
Establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-reference intelligence records and files

Some Of The Skills You’ll Learn

Critical thinking
The ability to use sophisticated mapping tools, intelligence networks, and systems to identify the evolving threat on the battlefield
Gather information utilizing premier digital and analytical tools to create products for the Commander

Helpful Skills

Analytical thinking; gathering information, and understanding of relevancy
Interest in reading maps and charts

More than any other branch of service, the Army National Guard offers a wide range of intelligence-related positions. Through your training, you will develop skills and experience to create opportunities for a civilian career with federal agencies like the National Security Agency.

Earn While You Learn

Instead of paying to learn these skills, get paid to learn. In the Army National Guard, you will learn these valuable job skills while earning a regular paycheck and qualifying for tuition assistance and certifications. Job training for an Intelligence Analyst consists of 10 weeks of Basic Training, where you'll learn basic Soldiering skills, and 13 weeks of Advanced Individual Training (AIT) and on-the-job instruction, including practice in intelligence gathering. You’ll learn in the classroom and gain experience in the field. Completion of your initial entry training in the Army National Guard could also lead to additional college credit.

Benefits/Requirements

Benefits

Paid training
Earn a security clearance
A monthly paycheck
Montgomery GI Bill
Federal and State tuition assistance
Retirement benefits for part-time service
Low-cost life insurance (up to $400,000 in coverage)
401(k)-type savings plan
Student Loan Repayment Program (up to $50,000, for existing loans)
Health care benefits available
VA home loans
Bonuses, if applicable

Most non-prior service candidates will initially earn between $200 and $250 per drill weekend, subject to change.

Requirements

Military enlistment in the Army National Guard
Must be at least a junior in high school, or have a high school diploma or GED certificate
Must be between the ages of 17 and 35
Must be able to pass a physical exam and meet legal and moral standards
Must meet citizenship requirements (see NATIONALGUARD.com for details)

Requires military enlistment. Programs and benefits are subject to change. Ask your Army National Guard recruiter for the most up-to-date information. Actual MOS assignment may depend on MOS availability.

We embrace a “work hard, play hard” mentality and celebrate individual and company successes. The Perks: As recognized members of the Cyber Elite, we work together in partnership to defend our nation’s critical infrastructure while building meaningful and exciting career development opportunities in a culture tailored to the individual’s technical and professional growth. We are committed to the belief that our team members do their best work when they are happy and well cared for. In support of this philosophy, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, major carriers for healthcare providers. Highlighted benefits include 144 hours of PTO, 11 holidays, 85% of insurance premiums covered, a 401(k), continuing education, certification maintenance and reimbursement and more. Who we’re looking for: We are seeking a SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance) to lead and manage all Security Operations Center functions. The SOC Lead will ensure unified service delivery across sub-task areas, provide operational direction and influence executive leadership to align security operations with enterprise objectives. The SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead role requires deep expertise in SOC management, incident response and hybrid on-premises/cloud environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the growth, development and culture of an exciting and fast-growing company in the cybersecurity market. What you’ll be doing:

Lead a 24x7x365 SOC for unclassified environments. Ensure shift managers and escalation contacts cover every shift and on-call support is available for incident response.
Coordinate task execution across sub-task leads to achieve enterprise-level objectives.
Oversee the integration and coordination of on-premises and cloud-based SOC capabilities.
Communicate effectively with executive leadership and stakeholders on SOC performance and posture.
Ensure SOC operations adhere to the full NIST Cybersecurity Framework: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover.
Manage dedicated business-hours coverage commitments for specific customer offices, including staggered shift scheduling.
Serve as, or direct, the Incident Commander for significant and widespread incidents. Responsibilities include: * leading incident calls * coordinating response across all teams and task orders * managing government notifications and stakeholder communications * tracking after-action items through remediation
Direct the task order incident coordinators within each sub-task area. Ensure playbook adherence and full incident lifecycle documentation in the ticketing system.
Oversee required reporting to federal oversight bodies, the Inspector General and law enforcement. Oversee reporting of classified spills onto unclassified systems.
Coordinate with interagency and intelligence community partners such as CISA, the FBI and DHS.
Execute the operational side of SOC consolidation: * onboarding new customer organizations’ log sources and alerting * standardizing detection logic, escalation protocols and playbooks * transitioning onboarded organizations into steady-state operations and maintenance
Develop and maintain SOPs, incident response playbooks, an alert severity and triage framework, and standardized reporting templates.
Own SOC performance metrics: mean time to detect, mean time to respond, alert volumes, false positive rates, ticket closure rates and SLA compliance. Explain any deviations and propose corrective actions.
Build a centralized incident knowledge base and lessons-learned repository that is shared across customer organizations.
Lead adoption of AI-enabled analytics and next-generation security automation.
Train SOC staff on operating procedures and ensure analysts maintain tool proficiency. What you need to know:
Strong background in cybersecurity incident response across large, complex enterprise environments.
Proven ability to align SOC functions with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
Experience coordinating subordinate managers and technical leads to deliver cohesive operations.
Skilled at influencing executive leadership and driving organizational adoption of SOC best practices
Hands-on SOC leadership experience with Splunk/Splunk ES and EDR platforms such as Trellix/FireEye HX and Microsoft Defender.
Experience with ServiceNow-based incident management, network intrusion detection (Snort/Zeek), threat intelligence platforms (MISP, STIX/TAXII) and vulnerability tools (Tenable, Qualys).
Experience managing 24x7 shift-based workforces, including scheduling, coverage, retention and escalation structures.
Familiarity with federal incident reporting requirements and OMB M-21-31 event logging maturity. Must have’s:
Bachelor’s degree or 3+ additional years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.
10+ years managing SOC operations and incident response for enterprise environments (50,000+ endpoints), including 5+ years leading hybrid on-premises/cloud SOCs with full NIST Cybersecurity Framework coverage.
Proven ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable tasks and processes through critical thinking.
Applicants must hold and maintain an active Secret clearance. Beneficial to have the following:
Hold one or more of the following active certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Security Operations Manager (GSOM), or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
Experience integrating multiple organizations into a consolidated SOC. Where it’s done:
Onsite (Washington, DC).

Titan Technologies is seeking a Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to support a mission-focused Government customer by delivering the full lifecycle of services needed to advance and modernize critical software capabilities. This includes developing, testing, integrating, and deploying enhancements to existing systems, as well as enabling the delivery of new and emerging requirements that drive mission success.

At a strategic level, the program establishes a unified and optimized Operations and Sustainment framework for legacy environments, incorporating Human-Centered Design principles to improve usability and effectiveness. By strengthening a Continuous Release model within the DevSecOps pipeline and expanding automation through robust Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices, it ensures the stability, integrity, and responsiveness of legacy applications and services, enabling faster delivery of new features, security advancements, and integrated products, and supporting long-term system performance and mission readiness.

The ISSM leads and manages cybersecurity efforts across enterprise applications and systems, ensuring compliance with risk management frameworks (RMF), secure software development lifecycles, and Intelligence Community (IC) standards. This role includes managing accreditation, conducting risk assessments, vulnerability testing, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain the highest standards of information security.

Oversee cybersecurity measures for applications in Agile and DevSecOps environments. * Design and develop secure systems, applications, and enterprise-wide cyber solutions. * Ensure system security needs are addressed across development, operations, testing, certification, and accreditation. * Conduct risk assessments, system hardening, vulnerability scanning, and incident response. * Manage assessment and authorization (A&A) efforts, including reaccreditation. * Track and manage Plan of Action and Milestones (POAMs) and recommend remediation. * Facilitate technical exchange meetings (TEMs) and coordinate with key stakeholders. * Develop security evaluation test plans and drive secure software development lifecycle practices, including containerization security per NIST SP 800-190. * Provide guidance on cloud computing services, deployment architecture, and network security tools. * Integrate new features into existing infrastructures and provide recommendations for security improvements.

10+ years experience in cybersecurity for intelligence systems.
CISSP certification required.
Expertise in security architecture, RMF compliance, and security engineering.
Deep understanding of compliance frameworks such as NIST or ISO/IEC 27001.
Experience working with or in the Intelligence Community (IC).
Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agilist or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.It’s GREAT if you also have:
Experience managing a cybersecurity team consisting of cybersecurity engineers, ISSOs and ISSMs.
Experience with developing, testing, and sustaining a secure solution in dynamic, rapidly evolving multi-cloud and multi-security enclave environments.
Experience managing a team responsible for developing and implementing enterprise security policies and practices.
Experience assessing and planning for compliance with DoD Zero Trust in accordance with the DoD Zero Trust Strategy and DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture.Education:

As the day-to-day owner of BatchMaster, our production and inventory management system, this role ensures that production batches, formulas, inventory transactions, and purchasing data are entered, reconciled, and reported accurately and on time. The Production Operations Analyst also assists with the daily reorder process so that our production and store teams have the ingredients, packaging, and supplies they need, when they need them. This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for a detail-oriented, systems-minded person who wants to grow a career in production planning, supply chain, and operations analytics at a fast-growing brand and highly successful manufacturing and distribution environment.

A key portion of this position will be to utilize AI tools to simplify reporting and provide management with actionable data in real time.

Core Responsibilities:

BatchMaster Administration & Daily Activities:

Own all daily BatchMaster MRP activities, serving as the primary day-to-day system user and go-to point of contact for BatchMaster questions.

Utilize tools within the software and AI to provide reports and trends that can help drive the business forward.

Create, schedule, release, and close production batches and work orders in BatchMaster in line with the daily production plan

Record production output, ingredient consumption, yields, and waste accurately and on time each day

Process inventory transactions in BatchMaster, including receipts, transfers, adjustments, and shipments to stores

Maintain accurate master data, including items, formulas and recipes, bills of material, units of measure, and vendor information, with review and approval from the Senior Manager

Reconcile system inventory to physical counts; support cycle counts and month-end inventory close, and research and resolve variances

Maintain lot tracking and traceability records to support food safety standards and recall readiness

Troubleshoot day-to-day user issues, serve as the liaison with BatchMaster support, and escalate system issues as needed

Create and maintain BatchMaster SOPs and job aids, and help train production team members on system processes

Support the continued rollout of BatchMaster, including testing new features, modules, and configuration changes as business needs grow

Daily Reorder & Inventory Support:

Assist the Senior Manager with the daily reorder process by reviewing inventory levels, usage, open orders, and production forecasts to recommend order quantities

Prepare and submit purchase orders to vendors and distributors based on approved par levels and reorder points; confirm order acknowledgments and delivery dates

Track open purchase orders, follow up on late, short, or incorrect deliveries, and communicate impacts to production and operations teams

Help maintain par levels, reorder points, vendor lead times, and minimum order quantities as volumes and store counts change

Match receipts to purchase orders and support invoice reconciliation with Accounting

Proactively flag potential shortages, overstocks, and aging or expiring inventory

Reporting & Analytics:

Prepare daily and weekly reports on production output, inventory on hand, usage, yield, waste, and order status

Maintain production and inventory trackers, spreadsheets, and dashboards, ensuring data is accurate and up to date

Analyze trends in usage, yield, and waste to identify opportunities to reduce cost and improve accuracy

Support ad hoc analysis requested by the Senior Manager, such as forecasting, ingredient costing, and planning for new stores or new products

Cross-Functional Support & Process Improvement:

Partner with Production, Warehouse and Logistics, Store Operations, Culinary, and Finance teams to keep information flowing and orders on track

Communicate production schedule changes, shortages, and substitutions to impacted teams in a timely manner

Set up new items and formulas in BatchMaster to support new product launches and limited-time offerings

Document current processes and recommend improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability

Education and Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, operations, business, analytics, or a related field preferred, or equivalent work experience

0–2 years of experience in production planning, inventory control, purchasing, supply chain, or data analysis; food and beverage manufacturing, commissary, bakery, or QSR experience a plus

Be adventurous and comfortable working and creating AI interfaces for analysis.

Experience with an ERP, MRP, or inventory management system (BatchMaster, NetSuite, SAP, or similar) a plus, along with a strong interest in becoming the in-house BatchMaster expert

Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookups, and basic formulas

Attention to Detail: Commitment to accurate data entry and record keeping, with a high standard for getting it right the first time

Analytical Skills: Ability to spot trends, identify discrepancies, and turn data into clear, useful insights

Organization and Time Management: Ability to manage recurring daily deadlines and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Problem Solving: Curiosity and persistence in tracking down root causes of inventory and system issues

Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication with internal teams and vendors

Learning Agility: Eagerness to learn new systems and processes, take feedback, and grow within the role

Commitment: Passion for food, operations, emerging brands, and the PopUp Bagel ethos — not famous, but known

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a computer workstation.

Ability to walk production and warehouse areas regularly, including in cold storage environments.

Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally (e.g., ingredient cases, supplies, inventory counts).

Must be able to communicate clearly in person and via digital channels.

Travel: Minimal; occasional travel to production facilities, vendors, or stores as needed.

Work Environment: This position operates in an office and production setting. Early morning, evening, or weekend work may occasionally be required to support production schedules, inventory counts, and month-end close.

Additional Role Note:

The duties of this position may change from time to time. PopUp Bagels reserves the right to add or delete duties and responsibilities at the discretion of PopUp Bagels or its managers. This job description is intended to describe the general work level. It is not intended to be all-inclusive.

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is a high-impact leadership role responsible for managing a portfolio of aerospace and defense development programs, new product introductions (NPI), and production transition efforts involving ruggedized electronic systems and mission-critical hardware. Reporting directly to the General Manager, the TPM serves as the primary customer interface and is accountable for program execution, financial performance, customer satisfaction, and successful delivery of technical and contractual commitments.

This position requires a technically strong leader with experience managing complex defense and aerospace programs from proposal and development through qualification, production, and lifecycle support. The ideal candidate understands the challenges of developing high-reliability products in regulated environments and can effectively lead cross-functional teams to achieve cost, schedule, technical, and quality objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a portfolio of aerospace and defense development, qualification, NPI, and production programs.
Serve as the primary interface with customers, ensuring strong relationships and proactive communication.
Develop and manage integrated program plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements.
Lead cross-functional execution across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Contracts, and Finance.
Ensure compliance with customer requirements, statements of work, technical specifications, and contractual deliverables.
Manage Estimates at Completion (EACs), Estimates to Complete (ETCs), revenue forecasts, profitability projections, and cash flow performance.
Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, schedule, supply chain, quality, and financial risks while capturing opportunities to improve program performance.
Lead proposal development, cost estimating, and bid activities for new business opportunities.
Conduct customer reviews, executive status briefings, technical reviews, and internal program governance reviews.
Drive successful transition of development programs into production while maintaining customer satisfaction and business objectives.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other STEM discipline.
8+ years of experience managing aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated technical development programs.
Demonstrated experience developing and managing ruggedized electronic systems, embedded electronics, power electronics, sensor systems, avionics, or other mission-critical technologies.
Proven success leading programs through development, qualification, production readiness, and manufacturing transition.
Experience managing government and/or prime contractor programs with organizations such as Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Raytheon, Boeing, General Dynamics, L3Harris, or the U.S. Department of Defense.
Experience managing program financials, including EAC, ETC, revenue, margin, and cash forecasting.

Critical Skills & Competencies

Strong technical understanding of electronic hardware development, requirements management, product qualification, verification, and validation processes.
Ability to interpret and manage compliance to customer, technical, quality, and contractual requirements.
Exceptional business and financial acumen with ownership of program profitability and forecast accuracy.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of customer and executive organizations.
Proven leadership of cross-functional teams in a matrix environment without direct authority.
Strong problem-solving, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to successfully balance technical performance, customer expectations, schedule commitments, and financial objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Department of Defense (DoD) development and production programs.
Familiarity with systems engineering processes, design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), qualification testing, and production readiness reviews.
PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials.
Active or previously held U.S. security clearance is a plus.

Why Join Us?

This role offers the opportunity to lead cutting-edge aerospace and defense programs that support critical national security missions. You will work directly with customers, engineers, and executive leadership to bring advanced technologies from concept to production while shaping the future growth and success of the business.

Onepoint en quelques mots

Créée en 2002 par David Layani, Onepoint est devenu en un peu plus de 20 ans l’un des acteurs majeurs du conseil et de la tech, notre collectif compte aujourd’hui plus de 4000 talents en France (Aix-en-Provence, Bordeaux, Lyon, Nantes, Paris, Rennes, Strasbourg et Toulouse) et dans le monde (Australie, Belgique, Canada, Etats-Unis, Angleterre, Malaisie, Maroc et Singapour). L’école Onepoint pour développer vos expertises

Nos lieux de vie

Nos espaces de travail sont situés au cœur des territoires, au plus près de de nos talents de concilier projet de vie et projet professionnel.

Et bien plus encore ...

Notre écosystème permet de pratiquer de nombreuses activités loisirs et sportives (musique, photo, e-sport, yoga…) avec un cadre de travail flexible grâce à une charte de télétravail, et de prendre soin de tous (cabinet médical en libre accès, groupes de travail dédiés aux enjeux « égalité et pluralité » …).

new_jobs.title: Juriste Data Analyst F/H
new_jobs.description:
Contexte :

Au sein de la Direction Juridique Groupe (DJG) de La Poste, le Pôle « Courrier, Colis, Nouveaux services & Legal Ops » a vocation à accompagner, sur le plan juridique, l’ensemble des activités développées par la Branche Sevices Courrier Colis du Groupe La Poste, et les filiales qui lui sont rattachées et sur le plan organisationnel de contribuer à la performance de la direction et de la filière juridique.

Le pôle « Legal Ops » apporte son expertise pour le compte du Directeur Juridique, son Codir et sa filière notamment dans les domaines suivants :

Pilotage du bon fonctionnement de la Direction dans l’écosystème interne et les relations avec les réseaux internes et externes
Suivi de la Data et des indicateurs de performance pertinents en regard avec les enjeux du Directeur Juridique pour sa filière et l’entreprise
Pilotage de projets transverses
Valorisation des actions des juristes et de la Direction juridique en interne et en externe

Son périmètre couvre les juristes répartis au Siège et en territoire au sein de La poste SA (150), mais s’étend également aux relations avec les juristes en filiales du groupe la Poste (300) et ceux du groupe Caisse des Dépôts (800).

Dans un contexte où le recours aux IA et IA Génératives ainsi que l’agentique sont devenus des standards, l’équipe Legal Ops accompagne et conseille la direction juridique dans ses choix d’équipements et outils et accompagne les juristes dans l’utilisation de nouveaux environnements de travail dans une logique de performance continue. L’enjeu principal est d’assurer une data de qualité, une capitalisation des connaissances, une homogénéisation des pratiques, une analyse d’architecture au niveau groupe avec un niveau de sécurité élevé et de non dépendance.

Dans ce contexte de très forte montée en puissance de l’utilisation de l’IA et des data, l’équipe Legal Ops a besoin, en renfort de la juriste chef de projet, de la documentaliste et de l’assistante de direction, d’une compétence technique en data analyse ainsi qu’en legal ingineering pour contribuer à l’activité de l’équipe sur ces nouvelles missions.

Missions :

Dans ce cadre, les missions principales seront, en étroite collaboration avec le responsable du pôle et l’équipe Legal Ops :

Contribution à la nouvelle architecture des solutions d’IAG et agents IA de la direction juridique avec prise en compte des systèmes d’information en place et la satisfaction client en interne
Suivi des projets de mise en place opérationnelle de nouveaux outils (RFI, Appels d’Offres,…)
Participation au pilotage des indicateurs de performance (reportings dynamiques et agentiques)
Gestion des outils actuels de suivi des contentieux La Poste et revue des process avec l’agentique
Actions de fiabilisation et de sécurité de la data juridique
